I have resolved the issue in [django/db/models/fields/json.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-7l01mlmk/django/db/models/fields/json.py):

- Added [`HasKeyLookup.compile_json_path_final_key`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-7l01mlmk/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L175-L177) and updated [`HasKeyLookup.as_sql`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-7l01mlmk/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L179-L210) so that the final key in `has_key`, `has_keys`, and `has_any_keys` lookups is compiled as an object key (`.%s` with `json.dumps`) rather than an array index (`[%s]`).
- Introduced [`HasKeyOrArrayIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-7l01mlmk/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L257-L259) and updated [`KeyTransformIsNull`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-7l01mlmk/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L393-L414) and [`KeyTransformExact`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-7l01mlmk/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L446-L483) to continue supporting both object keys and array indices.
